description: WebSockets keep a two-way connection open so either side can send messages without a fresh HTTP request. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Run npm init -y and npm install ws@8 in a practice folder. Save each example as lesson.mjs and run node lesson.mjs. Each file starts a local server and test client, prints a result, then closes both.
versionNote: Examples use the ws 8 package and Node.js 20 or later on one computer.
whatYouWillLearn: Receive a welcome message with WebSockets
Send structured message data with WebSockets
Close with a reason with WebSockets
learningObjectives: Receive a welcome message with WebSockets
Check a message shape with WebSockets
Check that a peer responds with WebSockets
